headline: Etsy Sellers Close Shops Over Marketplace's New AI Policy
summary: Numerous longtime sellers have left Etsy after the online marketplace introduced a policy allowing seller content to train artificial intelligence models.
why: Etsy Inc operates an online marketplace connecting independent artisans and vintage goods sellers with global buyers.

impacts.name: Etsy Inc
impacts.why: Shop closures and seller attrition reduce product selection and transaction fee potential on the platform.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
